pages.name: Box Between the Gears
pages.description: A small wooden box reinforced with iron bands is jammed between the gears. Its lid cracked on impact, but the rusty ironwork still holds it in place. A faded stamp remains on its side: "Bright River Station".

pages.name: Clattering Gears
pages.description: The mechanism shudders and turns with a crunch. The box splits apart, and its contents plunge into the dark shaft. The misaligned gears finally come to a complete stop.

scenePatch.description: The mechanism is misaligned and no longer taps. Splinters and scraps of felt lining remain between the teeth.

pages.name: Old Clock
pages.description: Beneath the bent lid, you find a small station clock. The iron reinforcement and thick felt lining absorbed the impact: the case is scuffed, but the glass and mechanism are intact. The black hands have stopped at ten past ten.
